title: Floyd Warshall
definition: An All-Pairs Shortest Path algorithm. Uses a 3D (or optimized 2D) DP matrix. Extremely simple to write (3 nested loops), but extremely slow: O(V^3).
simpleExplanation: Calculating the distance between every single city on earth to every other single city on earth all at the same time.

answers.question: **Basic:** Describe the fundamental approach for Floyd Warshall.
**Intermediate 1:** Add Memoization (Top-Down) to Floyd Warshall to prevent redundant calculations.
**Intermediate 2:** Convert Floyd Warshall into a Tabulation (Bottom-Up) approach.
**Advanced:** Solve a 2D matrix or multi-state problem using Floyd Warshall.
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize the space complexity of Floyd Warshall from O(N) to O(1) or O(N^2) to O(N).
